rows.title: Partial prepayment of $1.5 billion on the 2025 term loan due 2027 ($1.25 billion outstanding at September 30, 2026)
rows.detail: Honeywell 10-Q (10-22-2026): 'In August 2026, the Company made a partial prepayment of $1.5 billion on the $2.75 billion of borrowings outstanding under the 2025 term loan due 2027. As of September 30, 2026, there were $1.25 billion of borrowings outstanding under this term loan.' (date = August 2026; the day is not stated, month-end used).
